limitations: Only exact native account IDs within each source namespace support these historical associations. Salesforce and NexusCRM are separate; equal names or IDs across them do not establish a bridge.

Labels come from the existing 421-label catalog plus two separately reviewed labels. The catalog includes aliases, prospects and identities excluded from Hong Kong attribution; these counts are not confirmed affected Hong Kong companies.
Eligible means an unambiguous source-record association, not an active customer or current production use. Deleted, draft, expired and unknown observations remain included with separate flags.

Native record counts are distinct within each source namespace and record kind. Salesforce and NexusCRM can overlap in the real world; their totals must not be combined as unique customers, contracts or opportunities.
Lifecycle flags overlap and must not be summed. Multiple observed status values can come from separate status fields in one record and do not by themselves mean conflicting snapshots.
Expiry is assessed against 2026-10-21. A recorded end date before that date does not prove legal termination; an opportunity close date is not treated as contract expiry.
Missing or unsupported keys, ambiguous account names and conflicting document account references are quarantined. Missing matches do not prove absence of exposure.
These selected commercial tables do not establish gateway ownership, exposure of customer databases, downstream customer impact or current service use.
Swire Properties Inc. retains a group-connection caveat; this name is not substituted for a Hong Kong legal entity. Other label limitations from the existing directory remain applicable.
This export freezes one reviewed scan and publishes approved labels and aggregate counts only. Input, code, database or result changes require another review.
